latest_delivery.message:
Target 3 Set() requirement is not implemented. The requirement explicitly states: "Set(str string) parses the string back using fmt.Sscanf and sets each source binding to the parsed value."

Current sprintf.go line 69 just returns an error. It must:
1. Use fmt.Sscanf(input, s.format, &var1, &var2, ...) to parse
2. Set each source binding (s.sources[i].Set(parsedValue))
3. Special cases: Bytes.Set() returns error, URI uses storage.ParseURI
4. Return error if Sscanf fails

This bidirectional functionality is a core part of Target 3's specification, not optional.
